fact: By the ministry's mid-year review of 4 November 2025, interoperability maps linking the platforms managing civil-status registers and other administrative databases had been validated under the WURI project, with an integrator procurement of about 18 billion F CFA offered.
title: Burkina Faso: Projets et programmes du ministère en charge de la transition digitale - Un bilan jugé satisfaisant à mi-parcours
